verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.moss.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an agent-oriented summary of Moss. A second llms.txt at moss.dev/llms.txt indexes docs such as the CLI page, and a markdown pricing page (pricing.md) exists, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: evidence of a fuller agent doc bundle (e.g. llms-full.txt or per-page markdown across the docs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
